Short summary from Product/Infra:
- 99.95% monthly uptime is achievable if HaloHealth runs on Dedicated with a 2x reserved pool (to absorb failovers and planned maintenance).
- p95 <120ms is feasible for their expected token distribution if we pin them to a low-latency model family and enable KV/prefix caching.
- Operational controls required:
  * Dedicated cluster + reserved capacity (no shared noisy neighbors)
  * Warm standby in separate AZ/region for region-level incidents
  * Automatic fallback policy to a compatible but lower-cost variant for less critical traffic (we should define endpoints that opt-in)
  * Monthly joint runbook and quarterly DR test

Estimated annual delta: additional 35-45% across committed spend depending on cluster sizing. I'll get a sizing estimate and cost spreadsheets by 5/20 EOD.

Aditya Rao
Head of Product, Redwood Inference

Legal & Procurement note: We can support a tailored uptime commitment but with these caveats to limit liability:
- Cap on service credits per rolling 12-month period (recommend 6% of annual committed spend)
- Exclusions for force majeure, scheduled maintenance with 48h notice, and customer misconfiguration
- Requirement for Halo to maintain appropriate TLS/KMS configurations and to provide timely incident response windows (within 30 min of alert)

I'll draft a tracked SLA document that reflects the operational controls Aditya proposed. Kimberly — attaching a working draft SLA for your review.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Samir / Priya — thanks for your patience. Based on internal reviews we've drafted the attached SLA that outlines a 99.95% monthly uptime commitment for the dedicated production cluster plus a p95 latency SLO of 120ms for pinned endpoints. Key points summarized below:

- Deployment: Dedicated reserved cluster (2x buffer) with warm standby in a second AZ
- Latency: p95 <= 120ms for pinned endpoints when using the low-latency model family and KV/prefix cache enabled
- Credits & liability: service credit cap of 6% annual committed spend; standard exclusions apply (scheduled maintenance, force majeure, customer ops)
- Operational: joint runbook, quarterly DR test, 30-min incident response for severity 1
- Cost: estimated delta ~ +40% on committed monthly baseline (detailed spreadsheet in HubSpot link)
